Name: Flying Weapon Mount Mod (No longer Maintained)
Author: Darkmushu1
Description:
I'm quitting modding to explore other things in life, whoever wants to take over the project and or maintain just let me know and I can add a redirect link here to your Nexus mod page.

[b]What this mod does[/b]
Ride your current weapon as a mount at the cost of stamina or energy. Allows you to switch weapon skin to existing mod assets to ride as your flying mount. This mod works by itself but if you want additional enhancement like making flying an Ability with level up and option to use Energy or Stamina you can also download Unified Experience System. If your fine with hotkey that's fine, but if you're on mobile or want a UI Icon to toggle fly, you can add "Iconic Framework" mod, and it'll populate that icon for you. 

[b]Energy Drain[/b]
Stamina drain configuration also applies the same amount to Energy Drain. Energy gets consumed and doesn't regen unless no ability has been cast within the last few seconds acting as a global cooldown for all abilities.
[b]
Does it support Modded Weapons?[/b]
Yes, you can press F7 in game and select the weapon skin and it'll load in that weapon as a flying weapon mount that you can stand on.

[b]Platform Support[/b]
Works on PC/Linux, Does not work on Mobile reason in spoiler.
[spoiler]
The reason why it doesn't work on Mobile is because the game is hard code to take in control keys like W A S D or game pad to move a person flying. This can't be done on mobile at this time becomes mobile doesn't use this type of control instead mobile has a single tap and character auto moves. If you try it on mobile the flying character will not gain speed and will not turn and face the proper direction since these are controlled by W A S D and Up Down Left Right on Gamepad.[/spoiler]
